trap.label: stop doing ≠ stop to do
trap.wrong: I stopped to smoke last year.
trap.why: Em português "parei de fumar" e "parei para fumar" são claros. O aluno confunde o infinitivo: stop to do = parar PARA fazer; stop doing = deixar de fazer.

mcq.why: stop to do = parar para fazer.

mcq.q: Complete: Nothing can stop me **___** trying.

opts: I can't stop to think about it.
I can't stop thinking about it.
I can't stop think about it.

fix.wrong: I stopped to eat sugar last month.
fix.right: I stopped eating sugar last month.

fix.wrong: He stopped to smoke last year; he is healthier now.
fix.right: He stopped smoking last year; he is healthier now.

fix.wrong: The noise stopped me to sleep.
fix.right: The noise stopped me from sleeping.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva (deixou de): “She stopped to smoke.” → parou de fumar
Reescreva (finalidade): “He stopped drinking tea.” → parou para beber chá
Reescreva: “The rain prevented us from walking.” com stop
rewrite.answer: The rain stopped us from walking.
